target.name: target_level
target.unit: percentile of the target in its zone x week-hour train cell (0-100, mid-rank)

reference.period: split.train of base_config (issue hours in [train_from, train_to), target known)

volume_groups.rule: mean pickups per known hour of the zone in the train period
